stem.text: All the reactants and products of an exothermic reaction are gaseous.
Which statement about this reaction is correct?

A.text: The total bond energy of the products is less than the total bond energy of the reactants, and $\Delta H$ for the reaction is negative.

B.text: The total bond energy of the products is less than the total bond energy of the reactants, and $\Delta H$ for the reaction is positive.

C.text: The total bond energy of the products is more than the total bond energy of the reactants, and $\Delta H$ for the reaction is negative.

D.text: The total bond energy of the products is more than the total bond energy of the reactants, and $\Delta H$ for the reaction is positive.
